hook: Landlords in Newark just lost the right to force broker fees onto residential tenants.

sections.voiceover: Landlords in Newark just lost the right to force broker fees onto residential tenants.
b_roll: Exterior shot of a Newark residential building exterior
Close-up of a rental lease document

sections.voiceover: On October 13, 2026, a strict municipal ordinance took effect across Newark. The Newark Municipal Council passed this exact change by a vote of 9 to 0. Who pays the broker fee now?
Break this Newark rule and landlords face massive fines.
b_roll: Warning symbol graphic overlay on city street
Close up of rental contract terms

sections.voiceover: Landlords face fines reaching up to $1,250 for every single violation. The Newark Municipal Council shifted the financial burden entirely onto property owners. Tenants keep their cash.
b_roll: Financial document with red penalty stamp
Apartment keys resting on a lease

sections.voiceover: That 9 to 0 vote changed Newark renting forever.
